title: Sam Altman Says OpenAI Is Working Toward Self-Replicating Data Centers
summary:
The chief executive of OpenAI stated that the company's robotics program is being focused on the construction of autonomous facilities that can multiply their own capacity. This vision includes the use of AI-controlled robots to manage semiconductor fabrication plants, manufacture solar panels and build additional data centers to expand the company's compute infrastructure.

Sam Altman said the ability to create these self-replicating systems is now "within grasp," though he did not provide a specific timeline for when the robotics would be deployed to active construction sites.
